data.long_meaning: Binayansh is a Sanskrit name derived from the Hindu god Vishnu. The name translates to 'Lord of Victory'. It is believed that the name grants strength and courage to the bearer, and bestows victory in all endeavors. The name Binayansh carries the meaning “Lord of Victory” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Binayansh usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of victory and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.cultural_impact: The name Binayansh holds great cultural significance in Hinduism, as it is a devotional name that pays homage to the supreme god Vishnu. It is commonly used in Hindu communities and is particularly popular in India, Nepal, and among the Hindu diaspora. The name reflects the deep-rooted belief in the power and protection of Vishnu and the faith that He will grant success and victory.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Binayansh holds immense spiritual significance for Hindus. The root of the name "Bin" means 'Lord' or 'God', and "An" means 'protector', while "Yansh" refers to the god Vishnu. By bearing this name, the individual seeks the blessings and protection of Vishnu, the preserver of the universe. It underscores the belief in the divine omnipresence and the faith that the god is ever-present, guiding and supporting the individual in their spiritual and material pursuits.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Binayansh: The radiant one, who brings victory and prosperity. His light illuminates the path towards spiritual growth.

historical_references.reference: Binayansh was a famous king of Magadha dynasty. He ruled around 500 BC. His rule was marked by peace and prosperity, and he is remembered for his generosity and patronage of learning and arts.
Another reference suggests that Binayansh was a Jain Tirthankara, a spiritual leader who lived around 800 BC. He is revered in Jainism for his teachings on non-violence and renunciation.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name 'Binayansh' is derived from Hindu mythology and translates to 'one who brings prosperity'. In modern contexts, this name is embraced by various individuals on social media platforms to represent their personal journey towards growth and success. On Instagram, users with the name 'Binayansh' often share motivational content, personal development tips, and inspiring stories to connect with their followers. On YouTube, content creators with this name produce videos centered around spirituality, self-help, and mythological stories to educate and entertain their audience. Reddit communities, such as 'r/binayansh', are dedicated to discussions about the meaning and significance of the name in both historical and contemporary contexts.
